# OnyLab

> OnyLab is a software company that builds apps for independent restaurants and shops. It is based in France and was founded in 2020 by people who had run local restaurants and shops themselves. Its 5 apps take orders by phone, at the table and for takeout, organize their preparation, and copy customers and orders into Brevo and smsmode for email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns. They connect to the POS and the delivery platforms a store already uses through HubRise.

Every app reads from or writes to the store's HubRise account, where the POS and the delivery platforms already send their orders. A store keeps its POS, its payment terminal and its delivery accounts, and can start with 1 app and add the others later.

Contact: hello@onylab.com. Customers sign in to their apps at https://apps.onylab.com/.

Languages: this site is published in English at https://onylab.com/ and in French at https://onylab.com/fr/. Both versions carry the same content, and the English version is the source.

## Take orders

- [Order&Pay](https://onylab.com/#tour-orderpay): table and takeout ordering. Customers order at the table or for takeout and pay in 1 tap, with no app to install and no account to create.
- [OrderPicker](https://onylab.com/#tour-orderpicker): OrderPicker is the kitchen display system (KDS) for restaurants and the order preparation screen for shops. A step-by-step workflow catches mistakes and speeds up each preparation.
- [OrderPad](https://onylab.com/#tour-orderpad): phone order taking on a tablet or a computer. The caller's customer profile comes up from HubRise, the order is built from the HubRise menu with options, comments and the service mode, and it is sent to the POS through HubRise.

## Bring customers back

- [Brevo Bridge](https://onylab.com/#tour-brevo): copies HubRise customers and orders into the store's Brevo account and sorts them by visits, average order value and last order, for email and SMS campaigns.
- [SMSMode Bridge](https://onylab.com/#tour-smsmode): copies the same customers and orders into the store's smsmode account, for SMS and WhatsApp campaigns.

## How it fits

- [How the apps share data](https://onylab.com/#ecosystem): the apps sit around the store's menu, orders and customers, kept in its HubRise account. OrderPad, Brevo Bridge and SMSMode Bridge are listed in HubRise's app directory.
- [Your POS](https://onylab.com/#connections): POS systems connected to HubRise, and the delivery platforms Deliveroo, Uber Eats and Just Eat, connected to HubRise.
- [Questions](https://onylab.com/#faq): changing the POS, what HubRise is, using 1 app only, customer data, delivery platforms, support, and signing in.

## POS integrations

- [POS integrations](https://onylab.com/pos/): the POS systems listed in HubRise's app directory, checked on November 25, 2026, 1 page each. Each page says what the POS's HubRise connection carries (orders, customers, menu) and what each of the 5 apps does with that POS. In French at https://onylab.com/fr/caisses/.
- [Adixon Caisse](https://onylab.com/pos/adixon-caisse/): Table-service and quick-service restaurants; orders in, menu and customers out.
- [AKK EPOS](https://onylab.com/pos/akk-epos/): Softtech POS for Thai restaurants, in English and Thai, UK and Thailand.
- [AlFiManagement](https://onylab.com/pos/alfimanagement/): Web-based POS for German cafes and shops; it sends its menu to HubRise.
- [BonAppio](https://onylab.com/pos/bonappio/): Dutch hospitality POS that sends its menu to HubRise, without images.
- [CarréPOS](https://onylab.com/pos/carrepos/): Bakers and food shops; the connection works in both directions.
- [Clyo Systems](https://onylab.com/pos/clyo-systems/): Restaurants and retail in several French-speaking countries; HubRise orders in, menu out.
- [CSY Vector EPOS](https://onylab.com/pos/csy-vector-epos/): Hospitality and grocery stores; menu to HubRise, orders and customers back.
- [Delivery System](https://onylab.com/pos/talc-delivery-system/): Windows POS for takeout and delivery that sends its orders and customers to HubRise.
- [Drive Eat](https://onylab.com/pos/drive-eat/): Snack bars, bakeries and restaurants; 1 menu, orders in, variants not yet supported.
- [EatsTek](https://onylab.com/pos/eatstek/): UK retail and hospitality stores; EatsTek loads a menu kept in HubRise.
- [EPOS Technologies](https://onylab.com/pos/epos-technologies/): Hospitality and retail in 4 countries; sends its menu to HubRise.
- [eTakeaway Max](https://onylab.com/pos/etakeaway-max/): UK stores with online ordering; receives orders and customers, menu set in Catalog Manager.
- [French Caisse](https://onylab.com/pos/french-caisse/): Restaurants, bakeries, grocers and salons in France and Switzerland; orders in only.
- [Jalia](https://onylab.com/pos/jalia/): iPad POS from JDC for restaurants; HubRise orders in, menu out.
- [Kezia II](https://onylab.com/pos/kezia-ii/): Specialized retail and quick-service food; the connection works in both directions.
- [LEO2](https://onylab.com/pos/leo2/): Bakeries, restaurants and salons worldwide; orders, customers and menu flow both ways.
- [Lightspeed Restaurant](https://onylab.com/pos/lightspeed-restaurant/): iPad and cloud POS for restaurants and hoteliers, linked by a HubRise-built bridge.
- [Mealenium](https://onylab.com/pos/mealenium/): Restaurants on any device; menu with variants out, HubRise orders in.
- [MiiPos](https://onylab.com/pos/miipos/): Bars, bakeries, food trucks and shops on any system; orders in, no menu yet.
- [MyFoodFast](https://onylab.com/pos/myfoodfast/): Restaurants in the UK; sends its menu to HubRise, receives orders and customers.
- [Nestor](https://onylab.com/pos/nestor/): Delivery and takeout restaurants; orders in, menu and delivery time out.
- [NetFood](https://onylab.com/pos/netfood/): Italian food and beverage POS; it sends its menu to HubRise.
- [Next Order](https://onylab.com/pos/next-order/): UK, Australia and New Zealand restaurants; counter orders and menu go to HubRise.
- [OneTouch](https://onylab.com/pos/onetouch/): Versatile POS for restaurants and venues, set up from its own back office.
- [OrderLord](https://onylab.com/pos/orderlord/): POS for delivery and online orders; HubRise says it is not available in France.
- [OrderWire](https://onylab.com/pos/orderwire/): Web POS for delivery-first kitchens in Ireland, the UK and Thailand.
- [Panda EPOS](https://onylab.com/pos/panda-epos/): Restaurants with 1 or more locations; menu, orders and customers travel both ways.
- [PAR PixelPoint](https://onylab.com/pos/par-pixelpoint/): POS with 2 HubRise integrations: Bridge receives only, Windows API also sends the menu.
- [Popina](https://onylab.com/pos/popina/): iPad POS for bakeries, bars and hotels that sends its menu to HubRise.
- [POS HELPER](https://onylab.com/pos/pos-helper/): Cloud POS for restaurants. The menu is set up in HubRise's Catalog Manager.
- [Presto Express](https://onylab.com/pos/presto-express/): Restaurants and franchises in the UK; pushes its menu to HubRise, receives orders.
- [Quantum](https://onylab.com/pos/quantum/): Retail and hospitality stores in the UK; catalog pushed to HubRise, orders received.
- [Restomax](https://onylab.com/pos/restomax/): Belgian POS for table-service and quick-service restaurants that sends its menu to HubRise.
- [restoPOS](https://onylab.com/pos/restopos/): Cloud POS for restaurants, coffee shops and bakeries; it sends its menu to HubRise.
- [SwooPOS](https://onylab.com/pos/swoopos/): Mobile POS for hospitality and retail in the UK; menu to HubRise, orders back.
- [Synapsy](https://onylab.com/pos/synapsy/): French POS for caterers and retailers. Orders and customers arrive through HubRise.
- [TASK](https://onylab.com/pos/task/): Enterprise POS for Australia, New Zealand, USA; sends orders and menu only.
- [Tick'Eat](https://onylab.com/pos/tickeat/): Restaurant POS with its own delivery dispatch that sends its menu to HubRise.
- [Toporder](https://onylab.com/pos/toporder/): iPad POS for bakeries, butchers and wine shops that receives HubRise orders.
- [UltimaPOS](https://onylab.com/pos/ultimapos/): Retail and food POS from UltimaSOFT that sends its orders and menu to HubRise.
- [Vectron](https://onylab.com/pos/vectron/): Configurable POS from Shift4, sold by local resellers, that receives HubRise orders.
- [Yuze](https://onylab.com/pos/yuze/): UK hospitality; payments-first POS that pushes its menu to HubRise and receives orders.
- [Zelty](https://onylab.com/pos/zelty/): Zelty Bridge, by HubRise, passes orders and customers both ways.

## Delivery platforms

- [Delivery platforms](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/): the food ordering platforms listed in HubRise's app directory, checked on November 25, 2026, 1 page each. Each page explains how OrderPicker shows the platform's orders in 1 queue with the orders placed at the table or for takeout with Order&Pay, and the phone orders taken with OrderPad. Orders rung up on the POS appear too when the POS sends them to HubRise. It also says what the platform's HubRise connection carries. In French at https://onylab.com/fr/plateformes-de-livraison/.
- [Bolt Food](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/bolt-food/): Bolt's food and grocery delivery; menu, stock and delivery details in sync.
- [Delicity](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/delicity/): French platform with a fixed fee per order; menu, stock and delivery time in sync.
- [Deliveroo](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/deliveroo/): Restaurants and convenience stores; menu and stock published from HubRise.
- [foodpanda](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/foodpanda/): Delivery Hero group platform; orders and delivery details, menu kept in foodpanda.
- [Glovo](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/glovo/): Restaurants and convenience stores; orders, customers, menu and stock.
- [Hop Delivery](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/hop-delivery/): Home delivery in Geneva; orders and customer details.
- [Just Eat](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/just-eat/): Every Just Eat Takeaway.com brand; orders, customers, menu and stock.
- [Uber Eats](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/uber-eats/): Orders without the tablet; menu both ways, stock and the courier's position.
- [WeDely](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/wedely/): Luxembourg delivery platform; its menu, stock and delivery details reach HubRise.
- [Wolt](https://onylab.com/delivery-platforms/wolt/): Delivery and pickup; menu both ways, stock and final delivery time.

## About

- [Who we are](https://onylab.com/#about): founded in 2020 in France by people who had run local restaurants and shops. Figures stated on the page: 5 apps live on apps.onylab.com, 20+ years running local restaurants and shops then building software for them, support 7 days a week.
